units.note: All coordinates in pyxl units. 1 pyxl = 10px render. Neck-local origin = spinalpoint.

spinalpoint.note: Top of neck / spine. Attaches to skull at nasalpoint. Rotation source when chinpoint is not active.

adampoint.note: Adam's apple. Formerly applepoint. 12 pyxl below spinalpoint, 7 pyxl above vpoint.

vpoint.note: V of the neck. Bottom of neckbone. 19 pyxl below spinalpoint.

shapes.note: Canvas-accurate neck shape. Top 9w, bottom 11w, height 19 pyxl (spinal→v). Neck-local coords (origin = spinalpoint).

correspondence.note: Neck keystones mapped to skull-local coordinates (browpoint origin, Y down).

chinpoint_ref.note: Chinpoint is a skullbone keystone, 5 pyxl below spinalpoint / 7 pyxl above adampoint. Not owned by neckbone.

meta.width_note: Neck width not specified in v1. Typically ~chin width or more.
meta.derived_from: pyxl_skull_base.json v2 — distances: nasal→chin 5pxl, chin→adam 7pxl, adam→v 7pxl → spinal→adam 12pxl, spinal→v 19pxl
meta.changelog: v2: Added canvas-accurate neck shape polygon.
